rationale: Initial Gold selects the same authoritative Claude Code memory source and accurately maps instruction memory to layered static rules, Session Memory to progressive notes and compression continuity, and long-term memory to persistent storage plus dynamic recall. These three material layers answer the requested collaboration mechanism without requiring the broader six-layer taxonomy.

Initial Gold and the independent draft converge on the same authoritative source, the same three mechanisms, and the same replayable transcript regions: misclustering, condition loss through repeated compression, and narrow-experience overfitting. All material aspects are supported, so no revision is needed.
